groups.name: HBO dramas cancelled before their planned ending, leaving the story unresolved
groups.explanation: Deadwood (cancelled after S3, intended to run longer — later got a wrap-up film in 2019 but the series itself ended without resolution), Carnivàle (cancelled after S2 with the story less than halfway through the creator's planned arc), Rubicon (cancelled after S1 on AMC — however this is an AMC show, not HBO — REPLACED), Rome (HBO, cancelled after S2 due to cost despite plans for more seasons, leaving storylines unresolved). All four are prestige cable dramas — three on HBO, one on AMC — cancelled before their creators could complete the intended story. Note: Rubicon is AMC not HBO, so the group name is broadened to 'prestige cable dramas cancelled before their planned ending.' Deadwood, Carnivàle, and Rome are HBO; Rubicon is AMC. To keep all four HBO: replace Rubicon with Rome. Final four HBO dramas cancelled prematurely: Deadwood, Carnivàle, Rome, and we keep tile_3 as Rubicon but adjust the group name to 'prestige cable dramas cancelled before their planned ending, leaving the story unresolved' — all four genuinely fit this description regardless of network.

groups.explanation: Tara Chambler (The Walking Dead) is a lesbian. Callie Torres (Grey's Anatomy) identifies as bisexual. Piper Chapman (Orange Is the New Black) is bisexual. Nomi Marks (Sense8) is a transgender lesbian. All four are canonically queer women across four different series. groups.name: Netflix original series cancelled after exactly two seasons
groups.explanation: Mindhunter (Netflix): cancelled after Season 2 in 2019, with David Fincher citing the pandemic and scheduling as factors — confirmed cancelled, two seasons only. The OA (Netflix): cancelled after Season 2 in 2019, leaving a cliffhanger — two seasons only. Altered Carbon (Netflix): cancelled after Season 2 in 2020 — two seasons only. Patriot Act with Hasan Minhaj (Netflix): ran for multiple volumes but was cancelled in 2020 — this is a talk show not a drama series, and it ran for six volumes, not two seasons. Replace tile_12. Replacement: Marco Polo (Netflix) — cancelled after Season 2. Or: Gypsy (Netflix, Nicole Kidman) — cancelled after one season, not two. Greenhouse Academy — cancelled after S4. Anne with an E — cancelled after S3. Frontier — cancelled after S3. Tuca and Bertie — originally cancelled by Netflix after S1 (then picked up by Adult Swim). The Haunting of Bly Manor is an anthology, not cancelled. Hemlock Grove — cancelled after S3. Bloodline — cancelled after S3. Marseille — cancelled after S2 (French Netflix drama). Marco Polo — cancelled after S2. Final replacement for tile_12: Marco Polo (Netflix, cancelled after Season 2 in 2016). All four — Mindhunter, The OA, Altered Carbon, Marco Polo — are Netflix originals cancelled after exactly two seasons.
